header: PAPER DESK -- paper only, simulated maker quotes on the recorded Kalshi tape; not a verdict

figures.licenses: On MLB moneyline the pregame model trails the devigged close by +0.0039 Brier (95% CI [+0.0028, +0.0051], DM p 3.6e-12, n=13,992).

On paired in-play ticks the MLB in-game model trails the contemporaneous Kalshi price (Brier 0.2377 vs 0.2067, delta +0.0310, CI [0.0170, 0.0454], 227 games); the corpus later failed the join-integrity check and the 178-game segmented revision keeps the verdict.

figures.licenses: On NBA moneyline the gap to the Shin-devigged close, +0.0069 Brier (95% CI [-0.0038, +0.0175], DM p 0.20, n=372), is indistinguishable from zero and underpowered (MDE 0.0152).
Against the proportional-devig close the NBA moneyline gap is +0.0063 Brier (95% CI [-0.0042, +0.0168], DM p 0.237, n=372); same verdict.

scoreboard_arms.A: the venue mid at the tick, untouched (the reference every other arm is scored against)
scoreboard_arms.B: walk-forward fit on mid-only features over the state-complete population
scoreboard_arms.B_lag: the previous receipt's mid (a staleness control)
scoreboard_arms.C: walk-forward fit on the mid plus the sport's game-state features, same population as B
scoreboard_arms.D: C restricted to ticks where the pregame model is present; unavailable until a prior model row exists
